why: Rework audit 2026-11-01: of 28 pieces of work that day none was moved from its older owner, 8 rewrote an owner that already did the job and 10 left a second live copy, because nothing refused a rewrite and a session that sees only this repository could not see the old owner. Every feature file a change adds, or grows past grown_lines_over lines, is claimed by a contract in its tool's ports folder: a SOURCE_FIRST_PORT of the older owner (named by repository, commit and path; its first commit here is the byte copy; it keeps retention_at_least of the source's lines; the old copy leaves within old_copy_days_at_most days), or NO_PRIOR_OWNER with the search that found none, which the judge runs again. Judged by tools/check-a-port-against-its-source in this repository's root test (test/every-feature-file-has-a-port-contract.test.mjs) and at every commit and push on the Mac.
